author: felicepantaleo
body:
The muon interpretation pass added in #51412 pushes its merged MIP trackster into `resultTracksters` but does not push the matching entry into `linkedResultTracksters`.
The producer indexes the two vectors in parallel, so every result trackster after a muon trackster points at the wrong entry and the last ones point past the end. The producer then copies an out-of-range `std::vector<unsigned int>`  and throws.
title: Keep linked tracksters parallel to the result tracksters
